$comment: Content for the Windows 95 desktop behind 'My Departments', in desktop order. Each department becomes a folder with four text files: 'Info' (grading scale, overall grade and every single grade), 'Tasks & Focus Areas' (period, trainer, grade, then tasks), 'Trainer Feedback & Special Achievements' and 'Julian's Feedback to the Department'. grades and feedback follow the 8 criteria in fileSystem.js (CRITERIA); studentFeedback has one { grade, notes } per entry of STUDENT_CRITERIA. color tints the folder, its windows and its files. Empty lists render as placeholders.

departments.name: Cyber Security
tasks: Introduction to IT security and cyber security processes and handling of department-specific tasks in the first year of training.
feedback: Quickly became familiar with the people, the department and the tasks.
Acquired the required expertise and applied it successfully.

departments.name: Data Platform
